question: Should context-padding static evidence stay reviewer-only ClawScan input, or may it directly change GitHub-backed scan status and public suspicious visibility?
rationale: Current specs say static findings are input context and the PR changes that moderation/security boundary, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent policy.

options.title: Keep Static Evidence As ClawScan Context
options.body: Rebase the detector onto the current prepare/chunk/finalize GitHub scan flow and avoid changing public suspicious visibility for padding-only evidence.

options.title: Approve Direct Static Status
options.body: Allow padding-only static evidence to change GitHub scan status or public suspicious state, with explicit spec updates and live upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause Security Direction
options.body: Keep the PR draft or close it until the team settles the scan-boundary and visibility policy.

recommendation.title: Keep Static Evidence As ClawScan Context
recommendation.body: Rebase the detector onto the current prepare/chunk/finalize GitHub scan flow and avoid changing public suspicious visibility for padding-only evidence.
